बैंक िं ग प्र ौद्योकग ी में कि ास और अनुसिंधान सिंस्थान
(भारतीय ररजिव बैंद्व ारा स् थाकित )
INSTITUTE FOR DEVELOPMENT & RESEARCH
IN BANKING TECHNOLOGY
(Established by Reserve Bank of India)
Advertisement No: 01/2026 – 27 Date: May 06, 2026
Recruitment for the
Senior, Associate & Lead Executives
Requirements:
Institute invites applications from talented, passionate and ambitious technology
professionals to create and maintain appropriate and adequate IT infrastructure and
Platform for sustainable enablement of development and research in emerging
technologies. These opportunities will provide a unique opportunity to build,
maintain and support infrastructure for development and absorption of emerging
technologies having impact with India’s digital infrastructure under the guidance of
RBI. We are looking for enthusiastic and self-motivated human assets for adoption
and absorption of AI and its emerging incarnations, Blockchain/Tokenization,
Quantum and Post Quantum Cryptography, wider use of Digital signing in
identification and access management, etc.
The current Infrastructure includes premises Private Cloud, Multiple layers of
Network and Security to meet differentiated level of demand, requirement and use
in Development/research and live Operations. The operation areas include
Application/platform for Certifying Authority, Domain Registrar, Threat Intel Platform
(Sachet – IBCART 3.0), Systems for enterprise internal use, Cyber Range for
Supervisory Assessment, (CR for SA) (in collaboration with ReBIT-RBI :
https://rebit.org.in ) and also System and infrastructure for development, testing,
PoC and upgrade of existing Applications/Platforms and new system in pipeline.
The Institute (https://www.idrbt.ac.in/about-idrbt/):
IDRBT, the Institute, was established by Reserve Bank of India in March 1996
as a Society (under Society Registration Act). The mission and vision of IDRBT
continue to be brain trust for adoption and absorption of technology in BFSI sector
as envisaged by RBI. The Institute became financially independent since 2004.
The Institute, since its inception, has been engaged in research and
development of enabling platform/environment for emerging technologies and its
Page 2 of 7
integration and adoption, in BFSI sector. During its journey the Institute has
developed, grounds-up, the Indian Financial Network (INFINET), National Financial
Switch (NFS) – for linking of ATMs, Structured Financial Messaging System
(SFMS), National Electronic Funds Transfer (NEFT), Real Time Gross Settlement
Systems (RTGS), Domain Registrar, etc. and continue to be the Certifying Authority
under the Central Certifying Authority (CCA), MeitY, Govt. Of India for digital
signature certificates, eSign etc.
Over the period, the Institute has evolved as a prime center for Research,
Academics, Executive education, Consultancy, Development of Standards/
frameworks for AI, Cyber Security, Blockchain etc. The Institute had created and
continue to engage and augment the Forum for Chief Information Security Officers
(CISO in 2010), Chief Information Officers (CIO) Forum (2015), Chief Analytics
Officers (CAO) Forum (CAO) (2016) and recently the Fin-Tech Forum. Executive
Development and Certification Programmes form an integral part of the Institute′s
initiatives To meet the ICT industry and banking sector demand, the Institute also
runs the Post Graduate Diploma in Financial Technology (PGDFT), a full-time on-
campus one-year programme.
i. Job Location : Hyderabad
ii. Engagement Areas : Lead/Senior Associates, System
Associates/System Engineers
a) Application Security Developer
b) Development Security Operations Engineer
c) Security Developers
d) Digital Forensics
e) Network Security
iii. Job Description and Requirements:
Lead/Senior Associates/Associates/System Engineers
a) Application
Security
Developer
JOB DESCRIPTION:
✓ Perform manual and automated security
testing of web applications and APIs using
OWASP methodologies.
✓ Lead application security reviews including
threat modeling, architecture risk
assessments, and secure design
consultations for new product features.
✓ Conduct API security testing focusing on
authentication flaws, injection risks, and
business logic vulnerabilities.
Page 3 of 7
✓ Manage the application vulnerability
lifecycle: track, prioritize, and report on
findings through to verified remediation.
REQUIREMENTS:
✓ Bachelor's degree in Computer Science,
Software Engineering, or a related field.
✓ 3–5 years of experience in application
security testing and secure development in
a financial or enterprise environment.
✓ Strong proficiency in web application
penetration testing using Burp Suite Pro or
equivalent.
✓ Hands-on experience with OWASP Top 10,
OWASP API Security Top 10.
✓ Development background in at least one
language: Java, Python,
JavaScript/Node.js, or Kotlin/Swift.
✓ Knowledge of authentication and
authorization standards: OAuth 2.0, SAML,
OpenID Connect, and JWT security.
✓ Familiarity with static/dynamic analysis
tools.
✓ Familiarity with Digital Certificates and
HSMs is an added advantage.
b) Security Engineer
on premises for
Nutanix Private
Cloud Management
JOB DESCRIPTION:
✓ Operate and tune security tooling:
vulnerability management platforms, SIEM
integrations, and secret management
vaults.
✓ Collaborate with development squads to
remediate security findings and provide
security coaching within sprint cycles.
✓ Build and maintain security dashboards and
metrics to track vulnerability SLAs, mean
time to remediate (MTTR), and pipeline
health.
✓ Support incident response activities related
to CI/CD pipeline breaches, cloud
misconfigurations, or container escapes.
✓ Ensure DevSecOps, ISO 27001
✓ Evaluate and onboard new security tools
and advocate for developer-friendly security
tooling.
REQUIREMENTS:
✓ Bachelor's degree in Computer Science,
Information Technology, or a related field.
✓ 3–5 years of experience in DevOps or
DevSecOps roles within an enterprise or
regulated environment.
Page 4 of 7
✓ Hands-on experience with CI/CD platforms
(Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and
securing build pipelines.
✓ Proficiency with container technologies:
Docker, Kubernetes, and container security
tools.
✓ Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or
Azure) and cloud-native security services
(AWS Security Hub, GuardDuty, Azure
Defender).
✓ Knowledge of Infrastructure-as-Code
security: Terraform, Ansible, with tools like
Checkov or KICS.
✓ Scripting skills in Python, Bash, or Go for
automation and tooling development.
✓ Familiarity with OWASP SAMM, NIST
SSDF, or equivalent secure software
development frameworks.
c) Security Engineer &
Lead Operations JOB DESCRIPTION:
✓ Design and develop security tools, APIs,
and microservices to automate threat
detection, vulnerability management, and
compliance monitoring.
✓ Integrate security controls into CI/CD
pipelines including SAST, DAST, SCA, and
secrets management tooling.
✓ Build and maintain internal security
dashboards, alerting systems, and reporting
tools for SOC and risk teams.
✓ Conduct secure code reviews and threat
modeling for new features and critical
banking applications.
✓ Develop libraries and SDKs that enforce
cryptographic standards, authentication,
and authorization best practices across
development teams.
✓ Collaborate with application teams to
remediate vulnerabilities identified through
SAST/DAST scans and penetration tests.
✓ Implement and maintain identity and access
management (IAM) integrations including
OAuth 2.0, SAML, and OpenID Connect.
✓ Participate in the security architecture
review process for new digital banking
products and APIs.
✓ Document security standards, developer
security guides, and internal knowledge
bases.
✓ Stay current with emerging threats relevant
to financial applications (OWASP Top 10,
API security risks).
Page 5 of 7
REQUIREMENTS:
✓ Bachelor's degree in Computer Science,
Software Engineering, or a related field.
✓ 3–5 years of software development
experience with a strong focus on
application security.
✓ Proficiency in at least two programming
languages: Java, Python, Node.js, or Go.
✓ Experience with SAST/DAST tools and
integrating them into CI/CD workflows.
✓ Solid understanding of cryptography, PKI,
TLS, and secure key management
practices.
✓ Familiarity with OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, JWT,
and OpenID Connect standards.
✓ Knowledge of OWASP Top 10, SANS 25,
and secure SDLC frameworks.
✓ Experience building RESTful APIs with
security best practices (rate limiting, input
validation, API gateways).
d) Digital Forensic
Expert JOB DESCRIPTION:
✓ Conduct end-to-end digital forensic
investigations for cybersecurity incidents,
insider threats, financial fraud, and
regulatory inquiries.
✓ Perform forensic acquisition and analysis of
disk images, memory dumps, network
captures, and cloud logs maintaining strict
chain of custody.
✓ Analyze endpoint artifacts: Windows/Linux
file systems, registry hives, event logs,
browser artifacts, and email forensics.
✓ Investigate network-based incidents using
packet captures, NetFlow data, proxy logs,
and SIEM correlation to reconstruct attack
timelines.
✓ Perform malware triage and static/dynamic
analysis to determine threat actor TTPs and
scope of compromise.
✓ Prepare detailed forensic investigation
reports suitable for legal proceedings,
regulatory submission (RBI, SEBI), and
executive briefings.
✓ Support e-Discovery processes and
respond to legal holds in coordination with
the legal and compliance teams.
✓ Collaborate with the SOC and threat
intelligence teams to share indicators of
compromise (IOCs) and improve detection
capabilities.
Page 6 of 7
✓ Develop and maintain forensic procedures,
evidence handling guidelines, and
investigation playbooks.
✓ Stay current with emerging digital forensics
techniques, threat actor behaviors, and
financial cybercrime trends.
REQUIREMENTS:
✓ Bachelor's degree in Computer Science,
Cybersecurity, Digital Forensics, or a
related field.
✓ 3–5 years of hands-on digital forensics and
incident response experience, preferably in
banking or financial services.
✓ Proficiency with forensic tools: EnCase,
FTK (Forensic Toolkit), Magnet AXIOM,
Autopsy, or equivalent.
✓ Experience with memory forensics tools
and network forensics.
✓ Strong knowledge of Windows and Linux
operating systems, file systems (NTFS,
ext4), and artifact locations.
✓ Familiarity with cloud forensics on AWS,
Azure, or GCP (CloudTrail, Azure Monitor,
GCS audit logs).
✓ Understanding of malware analysis
techniques, sandbox environments, and
reverse engineering basics.
✓ Excellent report writing skills with
experience preparing evidence-grade
documentation for legal or regulatory
purposes.
e) Network Security JOB DESCRIPTION:
✓ Monitor network traffic, firewall logs,
IDS/IPS alerts, and SIEM dashboards for
suspicious activity and security incidents.
✓ Investigate and respond to network security
alerts, perform root-cause analysis, and
document findings with remediation actions.
✓ Configure, manage, and optimize firewalls,
VPNs, NAC, and network segmentation
policies aligned with banking security
standards.
✓ Conduct regular vulnerability assessments
and penetration tests on network
infrastructure; coordinate patching with IT
teams.
✓ Ensure compliance with RBI guidelines,
ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, and internal
information security policies.
Page 7 of 7
✓ Participate in change management
processes to review network architecture
changes from a security perspective.
✓ Prepare and present network security
reports and KPIs to senior management on
a regular basis.
✓ Mentor junior analysts and contribute to
threat intelligence sharing within the
security team.
REQUIREMENTS:
✓ Bachelor's degree in Computer Science,
Information Technology, or a related field.
✓ 3–5 years of hands-on experience in
network security within a banking or
financial services environment.
✓ Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, OSI model,
network protocols, and enterprise network
architecture.
✓ Experience with SIEM platforms, IDS/IPS,
and firewall management (Cisco ASA,
Fortinet).
✓ Familiarity with RBI cyber security
framework, PCI-DSS, and ISO 27001
compliance requirements.
✓ Hands-on experience with vulnerability
scanners (Nessus) and network analysis
tools (Wireshark, NetFlow).
✓ Understanding of Zero Trust architecture,
network segmentation, and micro-
segmentation concepts.
✓ Strong analytical, problem-solving, and
incident documentation skills.
.
Rules and Regulations
1. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.
2. Selected candidates will enter into an Employment Agreement containing
inter alia Code of Conduct and Non-disclosure agreement.
3. Interested candidates may submit their application through the link provided
on the Careers page of the Institute’s website, along with an updated CV, a
recent photograph, a valid identification document (such as an Aadhaar
Card), and a cover letter highlighting their suitability for the position.
Alternatively, candidates may apply by ☛ clicking here.
4. Queries if any may be sent pragati@idrbt.ac.in.
5. The preliminary scrutiny of the candidature and suitability will be considered
on the strength of the information submitted in the Application.
